result.summary: Found 1 issue: the bottom navigation bar is visually broken by a thick black bar overlapping and hiding icons.

issues.description: A thick black horizontal bar overlaps the bottom tab bar, obscuring the middle navigation icons (search and saved/bookmark) and making them unreadable and difficult to tap.
issues.suggestion: Add proper safe-area padding above the system gesture/home indicator, ensure the tab bar sits above it, and restore the system indicator to its normal thin size so all tab icons are fully visible.
